faq_heading: New construction in Abbotsford West: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Abbotsford West sold for?
faq.a: 143 condos sold in Abbotsford West at a median of $349,900, with the middle half between $287,500 and $427,500.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Abbotsford West?

faq.q: Which homes in Abbotsford West are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Abbotsford West, townhomes had the newest median build year, 2014.

items.t: 118 houses sold in Abbotsford West at a median of $1,023,564 (middle half $927,075 to $1,137,500). A typical house in Abbotsford West spent 19 days on the market and closed at 95.9% of the asking price.
In Abbotsford West, townhomes sold at a median of $635,000 across 101 sales, and the middle half closed between $590,000 and $695,000. The median townhome sat 26 days and sold for 97.7% of list.
Abbotsford West: 143 condos sold at a median of $349,900, with the middle half between $287,500 and $427,500. The median condo took 35 days to sell and closed at 96.4% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Abbotsford West compares with the rest of Abbotsford

items.t: Of 7 Abbotsford sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Abbotsford West ranks 4th highest at $1,023,564; the range is $925,000 (Poplar) to $1,575,000 (Bradner). Matsqui ($997,000) sits just below and Abbotsford East ($1,060,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Abbotsford West have the third highest median of 5 Abbotsford sub-areas, $635,000. Poplar is lowest at $580,000 and Abbotsford East highest at $720,000. Central Abbotsford ($620,000) sits just below and Aberdeen ($688,500) sits just above.
Condos in Abbotsford West have the lowest median of the 4 Abbotsford sub-areas, $349,900, below Poplar at $384,000; the highest is Abbotsford East at $456,000.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Abbotsford West (median 2014) and houses the oldest (median 1986), a gap of 28 years.
